001
002package dev.visdb.seesaw.utils;
003
004import org.openide.util.lookup.AbstractLookup;
005import org.openide.util.lookup.InstanceContent;
006
007/**
008 * Class used to house anything one might want to store
009 * in a central lookup which can affect anything within
010 * the application. It can be thought of as a central context
011 * where any application data may be stored and watched.
012 * This class has convenience method to modify the contents
013 * of the lookup. For stricter separation of reading and writing
014 * lookup content see <a href="https://bits.netbeans.org/30/javadoc/org-openide-util-lookup/org/openide/util/lookup/AbstractLookup.Content.html">lookup content</a>
015 *<p>
016 * A singleton instance is created using {@link #getDefault()}.
017 * This class is as thread safe as Lookup. Lookup appears to be safe.
018 * @author Wade Chandler
019 * @version 1.0
020 */
021@SuppressWarnings("serial")
022public class CentralLookup extends AbstractLookup {
023  private InstanceContent content = null;
024  private static CentralLookup def = new CentralLookup();
025  /**
026   * Creates a CentralLookup instances with a specific content set.
027   * @param content the
028InstanceContent
029to use
030   */
031  public CentralLookup(InstanceContent content) {
032    super(content);
033    this.content = content;
034  }
035  /**
036   * Creates a new CentralLookup
037   */
038  public CentralLookup() {
039    this(new InstanceContent());
040  }
041  /**
042   * Adds an instance to the Lookup. The instance will be added with the classes
043   * in its hierarchy as keys which may be used to lookup the instance(s).
044   * @param instance The instance to add
045   */
046  public void add(Object instance) {
047    content.add(instance);
048  }
049  /**
050   * Removes the specific instance from the Lookup content.
051   * @param instance The specific instance to remove.
052   */
053  public void remove(Object instance) {
054    content.remove(instance);
055  }
056
057  /**
058   * Remove all instances of {@code clazz}, then add {@code instance}.
059   * @param <T> type of interface remove/replace
060   * @param clazz class to remove
061   * @param instance add this
062   */
063  public <T> void replace(Class<T> clazz, T instance) {
064    lookupAll(clazz).forEach(o -> remove(o));
065    add(instance);
066  }
067  /**
068   * Returns the default CentralLookup. This can be used as an application context for
069   * the entire application. If needed CentralLookup may be used directly through the
070   * constructors to allow for more than one if needed. CentralLookup is nothing more
071   * than an InstanceContent instance wrapped in a Lookup with the add and remove methods
072   * added to make updating the data easier.
073   * @return The default CentralLookup which is global in nature.
074   */
075  public static synchronized CentralLookup getDefault() {
076    return def;
077  }
078
079  /**
080   * Convenience method to Lookup from the default.
081   * @param <T>
082   * @param clazz
083   * @return
084   */
085  public static <T> T defLookup(Class<T> clazz) {
086    return getDefault().lookup(clazz);
087  }
088}
